title: configure-plugins input
description: Choose the optional OpenBao plugins. Enabled plugins are downloaded (images pinned by digest), installed and declared; OpenBao restarts if the set changes (with manual unseal it must be unsealed again). Disabled plugins are removed with their images. Enabling a plugin in OpenBao (bao auth enable / bao secrets enable) needs an administrator token and is not done by the module.

plugins.description: Ids of the enabled optional plugins
